description_en: Deletes a node from an instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS集群系列实例删除节点
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-db-nodes --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --db-node-id rn-m8f0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDBNodes

parameters.description_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests.

The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符。
